long_biography.plain_text:
Alexey Mordashov was born in Cherepovets and returned there after studying economics in Leningrad. He joined the local steel mill as an economist in 1988 and became finance director four years later. During the plant's conversion into Severstal, he created investment funds that bought employees' shares, building a majority holding. He became chief executive in 1996 and led the steelmaker for 19 years before moving to the chairmanship.

Mordashov later diversified through gold producer Nordgold, engineering group Power Machines, retail and a stake in tourism company TUI. Bloomberg nevertheless identifies his 77% Severstal holding as the majority source of his fortune. His yachting history includes two vessels independently connected to him: Reuters identified Lady M as his yacht in 2022 and reported in 2026 that the 142-metre Nord was owned by him, while noting that public registration did not list him directly.
